findings: Current-base full validation is mandatory for each candidate; prevalidated parallel branches become stale after another merge.
Push and pull_request both trigger head CI; main push adds combined-result CI. No workflow change was made during the pilot.
Most phase wall time is local validation and observed head-CI wait; parallel merge, skipped checks or altered PR granularity would change the evaluated protocol.

A shorter poll can only reduce observation delay, not CI computation or queue duration; reducing the normal sleep only removes at most one intentional poll-sleep interval per successful observation; API/read failures can add separate delay.
Prepare of the next candidate already overlaps previous combined-result CI sampling, so that tail is not simply additive per PR.
candidate_future_changes_not_applied: Reviewed workflow event deduplication while retaining PR exact-head and main combined checks.
A new tested merge queue that validates exact speculative combined trees and preserves task granularity.
Dependency caching with the same required install/validation commands and separate measurement.
